Editorial advertising photograph, shot on medium-format film. A single matte pale sage-green aluminium can of sparkling water stands on a wet slab of dark grey granite at the edge of a still, cold northern lake at first light. Low mist drifts over the water; a soft line of black spruce on the far shore. Real condensation beads on the can. Cool natural overcast light with a faint warm glow at the horizon. The can sits on the right third of the frame; the left two-thirds is calm open mist and water, generous negative space. Restrained palette of slate, sage and bone. Fine film grain, true to life, quiet and premium. A small minimal label on the can reads ALDER in black serif capitals, nothing else. No other text, no logos.

Editorial still-life photograph for a premium sparkling spring water. A matte pale sage-green aluminium can and a short clear tumbler of sparkling water with rising bubbles stand on a rough slab of pink Canadian Shield granite. Hard, low morning sunlight from the left casts long crisp shadows across a warm bone-coloured plaster wall. Objects sit on the right third of the frame; generous empty wall on the left. Tactile textures, real condensation, natural colour, medium-format film look with fine grain, quiet and confident. A small minimal label on the can reads ALDER in black serif capitals, nothing else. No other text, no logos.
